description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, Iceberg table buckets, and Lance vector buckets, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(s3tables,s3vectors): bind DeleteNamespace and the vector bucket cleanup to the authorized records by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12331
* filer: allow renaming into a sibling that shares the name prefix by @fazpu in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12337
* compression: compress JSON uploads, and match file types by extension by @patwhite in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12339
* filer: reuse IsEqualOrUnder for the rename subdirectory check by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12338
* s3vectors: support TagResource, UntagResource and ListTagsForResource by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12335
* volume: replicas keep the primary's compression and metadata by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12350
* admin: manage S3 vector buckets by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12334
* admin: configurable file browser upload size limit by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12348
* build(deps): bump go.etcd.io/etcd/client/pkg/v3 from 3.7.1 to 3.7.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12344
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-python from 5 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12345
* build(deps): bump google.golang.org/api from 0.297.0 to 0.310.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12343
* build(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sts from 1.51.1 to 1.51.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12346
* build(deps): bump github.com/peterh/liner from 1.2.2 to 1.2.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12341
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 5 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12347
* s3vectors: support tag conditions in vector bucket policies by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12351
* build(deps): bump cloud.google.com/go/kms from 1.35.0 to 1.36.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12342
* operation: pad the marginal gzip test past Go 1.26's stored block by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12352
* filer: say jwt.filer_signing.key gates only the IAM gRPC service by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12353
* fix(s3api): reject an invalid storage class before uploading the body by @omninguyen in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12354
* s3api: known-answer fixture generator for SSE-S3 and filer-encrypted chunks by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12355
* test/s3vectors: a hardened cluster with TLS volume servers, read JWTs and encrypted chunks by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12356
* admin: summarize the EC delete_count accounting warning per refresh by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12359
* admin: scope plugin job and activity fetches to the selected job type by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12360
* fix(fsck): inspect references to deleted volumes by @Neo1228 in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12357
* shell: keep fs.mergeVolumes and fs.distributeChunks from reverting entries written while they run by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12362
* fix(storage): update deletion metrics in SortedFileNeedleMap.Delete (#12363) by @Tyagiquamar in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12364
* rust volume: count sorted-map files and deletes the way Go does by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12365
* filer.sync: skip a rewritten source version regardless of its mtime order by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/12366
* filer.sync: stop chunk retries with the same supersession check the skip uses by @chrislusf in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedf

[![SeaweedFS on Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/com.github.chrislusf/seaweedfs-client)](https://search.maven.org/search?q=g:com.github.chrislusf)
[![Artifact Hub](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://artifacthub.io/badge/repository/seaweedfs)](https://artifacthub.io/packages/search?repo=seaweedfs)

![SeaweedFS Logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/master/note/seaweedfs.png)

SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system. There are two objectives:

1. to store billions of files!
2. to serve the files fast!

One `weed` binary serves an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with S3 Tables, all over the same data. Each blob is one disk read away, capacity grows by starting another volume server, and cloud storage can be cached or tiered transparently. Both read and write operations have O(1) complexity and can run at the full speed supported by the underlying hardware.
